conditions.condition_text: Identify a trend (upward or downward) on the chart.
The strategy begins with identifying the overall trend.
Draw a trend line (Action Line) using at least two touch points (Point A and Point B).
The trend line is drawn to capture as many touch points as possible.
Enter a trade when price gets to or close enough to the trend line, anticipating respect.
The entry is based on price approaching the established trend line.
The trend line must be designated as both an action line (entry) and a safety line (stop/exit).
The trend line should have three or more touch points.
The stop is managed by the 'Safety Line' which dictates risk management and exit.
